cues: Some comparatives come from Latin and take to, not than: superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior and preferable.
He is senior to me; health is preferable to wealth; and with the verb, I prefer tea to coffee.

Patterns to memorise: taller than any other boy, because any boy would include himself; one of the busiest cities, with a plural noun; the more you practise, the better you become; and twice as heavy as.
